output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initial_supply parameter is provided by users, and the totalSupply is increased by this amount during minting. If initial_supply is sufficiently large, the totalSupply value will overflow, causing it to become very small, and allowing the owner to steal the funds of other users.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function checks if balances[msg.sender] < value, allowing attackers to overflow balances[to] and set it to any value, allowing attackers to steal funds from any user.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function checks if balances[from] < value, allowing attackers to overflow balances[to] and set it to any value, allowing attackers to steal funds from any user.

The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the amount overflows, allowing attackers to overflow the allowed[_spender] and set it to any value, allowing attackers to steal funds from users.
